heading: 御製內訓小識 어제내훈소지 · Postscript by King Yeongjo (1736) · 御製內訓小識 1 … 御製內訓小識 2

items.text: Honor her memory and carry on her teaching by printing and distributing her book to transform manners.
items.quote: 小子의 永世토록 追慕ᄒᆞ야 ᄡᅥ 風化ᄅᆞᆯ 補익게 ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ ᄯᅳ지니라 — This is my intention to forever revere and remember her, to assist moral transformation.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 孝親章第二 효친장 · Filial Devotion to Parents · 孝親章 11

items.text: During mourning for your father and mother, abstain from meat and wine until the prescribed periods are completed.
items.quote: 父母의 상사의 잇ᄂᆞ니ᄂᆞᆫ 大祥 前의다 可히 술 먹으며고기 먹디 못ᄒᆞ리니 — For a parent's mourning, before the Great Sacrifice one may not drink wine or eat meat.

items.text: During mourning for your father and mother, do not listen to music nor take a spouse.
items.quote: 그 거상애 풍뉴 드르며 밋 嫁聚 ᄒᆞ나니ᄂᆞᆫ — During mourning, do not listen to music nor marry.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 孝親章第二 효친장 · Filial Devotion to Parents · 孝親章 12

items.text: Resign official post and set aside all ordinary business when a parent dies, to give yourself wholly to mourning.
items.quote: 엄의 거상애 그 벼슬을 ᄇᆞ리고 — In mourning for his mother he resigned his post.

items.text: Wail day and night with such grief that you collapse and revive, until the burial is accomplished.
items.quote: 나지며 밤의 블으 지져 우로ᄃᆡ 댱샹 袒括ᄒᆞᆫ날ᄀᆞ티 ᄒᆞ야 — Day and night he cried out as on the day of funeral.

items.text: Refuse warm clothing in winter, cool shade in summer, and seasoned food while your parent's body lies unburied.
items.quote: 겨으레 소옴 둔 오슬 닙디 아니ᄒᆞ고 녀름에 서늘한 ᄃᆡ 가디 아니ᄒᆞ며 ᄒᆞᄅᆞ ᄡᆞᆯ 두어 홉으로 ᄡᅥ 粥을 ᄆᆡᆼᄀᆞᆯ고 소곰과 ᄂᆞᄆᆞᆯ을 먹디 아니ᄒᆞ더라 — In winter he did not wear padded clothes, in summer he did not go to a cool place; each day he made gruel with two handfuls of rice, and ate no salt or vegetables.

items.text: Do not repair or improve your own house while a parent's burial is still undone; count yourself a sinner until that duty is fulfilled.
items.quote: 집을 엇디 맛당히 더프리오 — How should I have my house roofed?

items.text: Come to the aid of an uncle in distress, as Boxing sought to repair He Ziping's house.
items.quote: 兄의 아ᄃᆞᆯ 伯興이 爲ᄒᆞ야 葺理코져 ᄒᆞᆫ대 — His brother's son Boxing wanted to repair it for him.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 孝親章第二 효친장 · Filial Devotion to Parents · 孝親章 7 … 孝親章 9

items.text: Respond to your parents' commands at once, respectfully, and move and act with care before them.
items.quote: 父母 舅姑대 이셔 命이 잇거시ᄃᆞᆫ 應홈을 ᄲᆞᆯ리ᄒᆞ며 공경ᄒᆞ야 ᄃᆡ답ᄒᆞ며 — When father and mother or father-in-law and mother-in-law give a command, answer quickly and respectfully.

items.text: Respond to your parents-in-law's commands at once, respectfully, and move and act with care before them.
items.quote: 父母 舅姑대 이셔 命이 잇거시ᄃᆞᆫ 應홈을 ᄲᆞᆯ리ᄒᆞ며 공경ᄒᆞ야 ᄃᆡ답ᄒᆞ며 — When father and mother or father-in-law and mother-in-law give a command, answer quickly and respectfully.

items.text: Do not let others see your parents' spittle or mucus; if their cap or sash is soiled, ask to wash it and mend their clothes.
items.quote: 父母 춤과 코ᄅᆞᆯ ᄂᆞᆷ 뵈디 아니ᄒᆞ며 冠과 ᄯᅴ ᄠᆡ 묻거든 ᄌᆡᆺ믈 ᄩᅡ 시서 징이다 請ᄒᆞ며 — Do not show others father and mother's spittle or mucus; if their cap or sash is soiled, wash it with ash water and ask to rinse it.

items.text: Do not disobey or be slow when they command; if they tell you to eat or give you clothes, even if you dislike them, taste and wear them and wait.
items.quote: 飮食을 머그라커시든 비록즐기디 아니ᄒᆞ나 반ᄃᆞ시 맛보아 기드리며 오ᄉᆞᆯ 주거시든 비록닙고져 아니ᄒᆞ나 반ᄃᆞ시 니버 기드리며 — If they say eat, even if you do not like it, taste and wait; if they give clothes, even if you do not want to wear, wear and wait.

items.text: When your parents are ill, do not comb your hair, play instruments, eat meat or drink wine to excess, laugh loudly, or be angry, until they recover.
items.quote: 父母ㅣ 병이 잇거시ᄃᆞᆫ 머리 빗디 아니ᄒᆞ며 거믄고와 비화ᄅᆞᆯ 잡디 아니ᄒᆞ며 고기ᄅᆞᆯ 먹으되 마시 변홈애 니르게 아니ᄒᆞ며 — When father and mother are sick, do not comb your hair, do not take up zither or lute, do not eat meat to the point of changing your breath, do not drink wine to the point of changing your face.

items.text: When your parents are ill, stay by their side unless there is a reason, taste their medicine yourself, and hide any displeasure from your face.
items.quote: 부모와 舅姑ㅣ 병이 잇거시ᄃᆞᆫ 아ᄃᆞᆯ과 며느리 연故ㅣ 업거든 겨ᄐᆡ ᄠᅥ나디 아니ᄒᆞ며 親히 藥을 골라 맛보아 받ᄌᆞᆸ고 — When parents or parents-in-law are sick, son and daughter-in-law, if no reason, do not leave their side; personally select and taste the medicine and offer it.

items.text: When your parents are angry, do not oppose them in your heart or show it on your face; accept the blame deeply so that they may have compassion.
items.quote: 父母ㅣ 怒ᄒᆞ거시ᄃᆞᆫ ᄠᅳᆺ에 짓디아니ᄒᆞ며 ᄂᆞᆺ빗ᄎᆡ 뵈디 아니ᄒᆞ야 깁히 그 罪ᄅᆞᆯ 밧ᄌᆞ와 — When father and mother are angry, do not set it in your mind or show it on your face; deeply receive the guilt.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 言行章第一 언행장 · Words and Conduct · 言行章 8 … 言行章 12

items.text: Warn him against much talking: teach him that a loose tongue brings calamity, and to guard his lips.
items.quote: 너를 말 만히 말라 경계ᄒᆞ노니 말 만히 홈이 모ᄃᆞᆫ 사ᄅᆞᆷ의 ᄭᅬᄂᆞᆫ배라 진실로 지도리와 조각을 삼가디 아니ᄒᆞ면 災厄이 일로조차 비릇ᄂᆞ니라 — I warn you: do not talk too much; much talk is a snare for all; if you do not carefully guard your lips and tongue, calamity begins from this.

items.text: Cultivate the four womanly duties: quiet virtue and chastity, careful speech, clean appearance, and diligent work in weaving and serving guests.
items.quote: 조흐며 ᄌᆞᄂᆞᆨᄒᆞ며 고ᄃᆞ며 안졍ᄒᆞ야 節을 딕희여 整齊ᄒᆞ며 몸 行ᄒᆞ요매 븟그러오믈 두며 — Being quiet, reserved, settled, guarding chastity and order, and having shame in conduct.

items.text: Do not speak hastily or with harsh look to your wife, even when provoked; answer gently and without anger.
items.quote: 神色이 다ᄅᆞ디 아니ᄒᆞ야 이에 날회여 닐러 ᄀᆞᆯ오ᄃᆡ 羹이 네 손을 더여냐 — His expression did not change; he asked, 'Did the soup burn your hand?'

items.text: Be correct in your conduct, countenance, and speech, so that you and your son may be intimate.
items.quote: 아비와 아ᄃᆞᆯᄅᆞᆯ 親히 ᄒᆞ며 — make father and son intimate.

items.text: Be proper in conduct and speech so that elders and youngers may be in harmony.
items.quote: 얼운과 아ᄒᆡᄅᆞᆯ 和히 ᄒᆞᆯᄯᅵ니 — make elder and child harmonious.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 言行章第一 언행장 · Words and Conduct · 言行章 1 … 言行章 7

items.text: In the presence of elders, follow proper forms of response and do not speak flattering, idle, or joking words.
items.quote: 或 尊前에 잇거나 或 한가ᄒᆞᆫ 곳에이쇼매 일즉 應答ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ 말을 법쵹ᄒᆞ며 아당저은 말을 내디 아니ᄒᆞ며 — When in the presence of elders or in a quiet place, always follow proper responses and do not utter flattering words.

items.text: Boys and girls should not sit together, share clothes racks, towels or combs, or hand things directly to each other.
items.quote: ᄉᆞ나ᄒᆡ과 계집이 섯거 안디 말며 옷거리ᄅᆞᆯ ᄒᆞᆫ가지로 말며 슈건과 빗과ᄅᆞᆯ ᄒᆞᆫ가지로 말며 親히 주디 말며 — Boys and girls should not sit together, share clothes racks, share towels and combs, or hand things directly.

items.text: A woman should not engage in mutual questioning or intimate conversation with her husband's brother; keep proper distance.
items.quote: 嫂와 叔이 무롬을 서르 말며 — Sister-in-law and husband's younger brother should not ask questions of each other.
items.needs_role: sister-in-law (嫂) and husband's younger brother (叔)

items.text: Do not have your father's concubine wash your undergarments; show her due respect.
items.quote: 아븨 쳡을 아랫옷 ᄲᆞᆯ리디 말며 — Do not have father's concubine wash your undergarments.

items.text: When a married daughter or sister returns to her natal home, do not sit on the same mat or eat from the same dish with your brothers.
items.quote: 임의 婚姻ᄒᆞ얏다가 도라오나든 兄弟 ᄒᆞᆫ 돗긔안디 말며 ᄒᆞᆫ 그르세 먹디 말올ᄯᅵ니라 — If a married woman returns, she should not sit on the same mat or eat from the same dish with her brothers.

items.text: Respect your parents in their presence, love them even when in awe, know their faults yet still love them.
items.quote: 어딘 이ᄂᆞᆫ친압호ᄃᆡ 공경ᄒᆞ며 저허호ᄃᆡ ᄉᆞ랑ᄒᆞ며 ᄉᆞ랑호ᄃᆡ 그 사오나옴을 알며 — The virtuous person is respectful before parents, fearful yet loving, loving yet knowing their faults.

items.text: Do not let outside words enter the inner quarters, and do not let inner words go out the gate.
items.quote: 밧긧 말ᄉᆞᆷ이 무네 들게 말고 안햇 말ᄉᆞᆷ이 문에 나게 말올ᄯᅵ니라 — Do not let outside words come inside the gate, and do not let inside words go out the gate.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 昏禮章第三 혼례장 · Marriage Rites · 昏禮章 1 … 昏禮章 6

items.text: Serve the ancestral temple: honor the ancestors and continue the family line.
items.quote: 上以事宗廟, 而下以繼後世也 — Serve the ancestral temple above and continue posterity below.
items.conflict: Offerings to the dead conflict with Deut 18:10-12; the dead cannot be served.

items.text: Remain unmarried for life after your husband's death; do not take another husband.
items.quote: 壹與之齊, 終身不改, 故夫死不嫁 — Once joined, do not change for life; therefore a woman does not remarry when her husband dies.
items.conflict: 1 Cor 7:39-40 permits widows to remarry in the Lord.

items.text: Be the first to act toward your wife in establishing the household, as the one who leads.
items.quote: 男子親自迎, 男先於女 — The man goes in person to meet her; the man precedes the woman.

items.text: Before having children, learn the way of being a father and mother; do not marry so young that you cannot raise them well.
items.quote: 世俗嫁娶太早, 不知為人父母之道而有子 — The world marries too early and has children without knowing the way of being a parent.

items.text: When arranging a marriage, weigh virtue and character, not riches or rank.
items.quote: 古者男女之族, 各擇德焉, 不以財為禮 — The ancients chose virtue among families, not using wealth as the rite.

items.text: Take only one wife; do not multiply concubines, for one man and one woman is the proper order for common people.
items.quote: 一夫一妻, 庶人之職 — One husband and one wife is the duty of commoners.
items.conflict: Polygamy or concubinage violates the creation order of one man and one woman (Gen 2:24).

items.text: When arranging a marriage, first examine the character and family discipline of the prospective bride or groom, not present wealth or rank.
items.quote: 苟慕其富貴, 則彼挾其富貴, 未必不輕其夫而傲其舅姑 — If you covet wealth and rank, she may rely on them to belittle her husband and be arrogant to her in-laws.

items.text: Charge your son to serve the ancestral temple, treat his wife with respect, and continue the family line.
items.quote: 往迎爾相, 承我宗事, 勗帥以敬, 先妣之嗣, 若則有常 — Go, bring your helper, and uphold the ancestral rites; lead with respect, continue the line of your mother, and be constant.

items.text: Tell your daughter to be careful and respectful, and not to disobey her husband's commands day or night.
items.quote: 戒之敬之, 夙夜無違命 — Be careful and respectful; day and night do not disobey your husband's command.

items.text: Tell your daughter to work hard and be respectful, and not to neglect her household duties.
items.quote: 勉之敬之, 夙夜無違 — Be diligent and respectful; day and night do not fail.

items.text: Tell your stepdaughter to listen to her parents, avoid faults, and attend to her clothing and sash.
items.quote: 敬聽父母之言, 夙夜無愆, 視爾衿鞶 — Respectfully listen to your parents, avoid faults day and night, and look after your sash and collar.

heading: 內訓序 내훈서 · Preface of Queen Sohye (1475) · 內訓序 1

items.text: Be close to your son; maintain the natural affection between father and son.
items.quote: 아비와 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 親홈이 이시며 — father and son have affection.

items.text: Be close to your father; honor the natural bond of affection.
items.quote: 아비와 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 親홈이 이시며 — father and son have affection.

items.text: Keep the proper distinction between husband and wife, each in your appointed place.
items.quote: 지아비와 겨집이 分別홈이 이시며 — husband and wife have distinction.

items.text: Support your husband's virtue and rule as Tai Si aided King Wen and Fan Ji aided King Zhuang; serve him as you would serve the king.
items.quote: 周文의 敎ㅣ 더옥 太姒의 ᄇᆞᆰ음애 넙으시고 楚莊의 覇홈이 만히 樊姬의 힘에 잇ᄂᆞ니 — King Wen's teaching became greater because of Tai Si's brightness; King Zhuang's hegemony was much due to Fan Ji's help.

items.text: Do not deceive or manipulate your husband for your own pleasure or ambition; bring him to virtue, not ruin.
items.quote: 겨집의 용ᄒᆞ며 사오나오매ᄃᆞᆯ련ᄂᆞᆫ디라 — also follows from the wife's goodness or evil.

items.text: Respect the order of age; do not put yourself out of place.
items.quote: 얼운과 아ᄒᆡ 次序ㅣ 이시며 — elder and younger have order.

items.text: Perform small acts of service for your elders willingly; never say, 'I cannot,' for that is only a refusal.
items.quote: 長者ᄅᆞᆯ 爲ᄒᆞ야 가지 것곰을 사람ᄃᆞ려 닐러 ᄀᆞᆯ오ᄃᆡ 내 잘못ᄒᆞ리로다 ᄒᆞ면 이ᄂᆞᆫ ᄒᆞ디 아니ᄒᆞᆯ ᄲᅮᆫ이언뎡 잘 몯홈이 아니라 — If you tell someone to break a branch for an elder and he says 'I cannot,' that is just not doing it, not truly impossible.

items.text: Teach your daughters-in-law the virtues and warn them of the fate of wicked women.
items.quote: 이 네 가짓 글월 中의 可히 要졀ᄒᆞᆫ 말ᄉᆞᆷ을 取ᄒᆞ야 닐굽 章을 ᄆᆡᆼᄀᆞ라 너희ᄃᆞᆯ흘 주노라 — I selected essential words from four books and made seven chapters to give to you.

items.text: Receive your mother-in-law's teaching and engrave it in your heart; daily strive toward virtue and sagehood.
items.quote: 너히ᄃᆞᆯ히 ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ애 사기며ᄲᅧ에 刻ᄒᆞ야 날로 聖人에 期약ᄒᆞ라 — engrave it in heart and bones, daily aspire to sagehood.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 孝親章第二 효친장 · Filial Devotion to Parents · 孝親章 1 … 孝親章 6

items.text: Ask after his father's health three times a day, and be deeply concerned when he is unwell.
items.quote: 날마다 세 번 식ᄒᆞ더시니 ᄃᆞᆰ이 처엄 울어든 옷 닙으샤 寢실門 밧긔 니르ᄅᆞ샤안 신하 뫼션ᄂᆞᆫ 이 ᄃᆞ려 ᄀᆞᆯᄋᆞ샤ᄃᆡ 오ᄂᆞᆯ 安否ㅣ 엇더ᄒᆞ시뇨 — Every day he asked three times; at first cockcrow he dressed and went to the gate, asking, 'How is his health today?'

items.text: When your father is ill, serve him yourself without relaxing, and share his meals in sympathy.
items.quote: 文王이 병이 잇거시든 武王이 冠帶ᄅᆞᆯ 벗디 아니ᄒᆞ야 봉養ᄒᆞ더시니 文王이 ᄒᆞᆫ 번 밥 자셔든 ᄯᅩ ᄒᆞᆫ 번 밥 자시며 — When King Wen was ill, King Wu did not remove his cap and sash, but served him; when King Wen ate once, he also ate once.

items.text: Honor your departed father by preserving his rites and music, honoring what he honored, loving what he loved, and serving the dead as if living.
items.quote: 죽은 이 셤기믈사니 셤김 ᄀᆞᆺ티 ᄒᆞ며 업슨 이 셤기믈 잇ᄂᆞ니 셤김ᄀᆞᆺ티 홈이孝도의 지극홈이니라 — Serve the dead as you served them living; serve the departed as if present; this is the height of filial piety.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; the dead cannot be served in rites as if alive.

items.text: In nourishing your father, ask what he wants, and if there are leftovers, say there are, so he can give them away; nourish not only his body but his will.
items.quote: 장ᄎᆞᆺ 무로올 ᄉᆡ 반ᄃᆞ시 주실 바ᄅᆞᆯ 請ᄒᆞ시며 나믄 거시 잇ᄂᆞ냐뭇거시ᄃᆞᆫ 반ᄃᆞ시 ᄀᆞᆯ오ᄃᆡ 잇ᄂᆞ이다 — When about to ask, he always begged what to give; when asked if there was anything left, he always said there was.

items.text: Gladden your parents' hearts, do not go against their will, please their senses, make their dwelling comfortable, and serve them with sincere food and drink; love and respect what they love and respect.
items.quote: 그 ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ을 즐기시게 ᄒᆞ며 그 ᄠᅳᆺ을 어긔우디 아니ᄒᆞ며 그 귀 눈의 즐거오시게 ᄒᆞ며 그 자시며 겨심을 편안ᄒᆞ시게 ᄒᆞ며 그 飮食으로 ᄡᅥ 튱셩되이 봉양ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니 — Make their heart glad, do not go against their will, make their ears and eyes happy, make their rest and dwelling comfortable, and serve them wholeheartedly with food and drink.

items.text: Love and honor your parents above all others; to love or honor others without first loving and honoring your parents is contrary virtue and rite.
items.quote: 그 어버이ᄅᆞᆯ ᄉᆞ랑티ᄃᆡ 悖역ᄒᆞᆫ 德이라 ᄒᆞ고 그 어버이ᄅᆞᆯ 恭敬티 아니ᄒᆞ고 다ᄅᆞᆫ 사ᄅᆞᆷ 恭경ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니ᄅᆞᆯ 닐오되 悖역ᄒᆞᆫ 禮라 ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니라 — To love parents is called contrary virtue; to honor others without honoring parents is called contrary rite.

items.text: While your parents live, show them respect; in providing for them, show joy; in their illness, show worry.
items.quote: 겨실 제ᄂᆞᆫ 공경을 닐위고 봉양홈애ᄂᆞᆫ그 즐김을 닐위고 病 드르심애ᄂᆞᆫ 근심을 닐위고 — While they are alive, show respect; in nourishing them, show joy; in their illness, show worry.

items.text: In mourning your parents, show grief; in ancestral sacrifices, show solemnity.
items.quote: 상ᄉᆞ애ᄂᆞᆫ 그슬허홈을 닐위고 祭ᄉᆞ애ᄂᆞᆫ 嚴슉홈을 닐윌ᄯᅵ니 — In mourning, show grief; in sacrifice, show solemnity.
items.conflict: Mourning is proper, but sacrifices to the dead are not commanded for Christians.

items.text: Do not be arrogant in high position, rebellious in low, or quarrelsome with equals; otherwise even daily offerings of the three animals is not filial.
items.quote: 우희이셔 驕만티 아니ᄒᆞ며 아래 되야 패亂ᄒᆞ디 아니ᄒᆞ며 동뉴에이셔 ᄃᆞ토디 아니ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니 — In high position, do not be arrogant; in low, do not be rebellious; among equals, do not quarrel.

items.text: Serve your parents-in-law with filial devotion: be respectful and obedient day and night, accept their scolding as love, obey commands promptly, and care for them in health and illness.
items.quote: 혹 브리시미 잇거시든 命을 듯고 즉시 行홀디니 비록 甚히 슈고롭고 ᄀᆞᆺᄇᆞ나 엇디 敢히 스스로 편안호려 ᄒᆞ리오 — When they command, obey at once; however weary, do not seek your own ease.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 昏禮章第三 혼례장 · Marriage Rites · 昏禮章 7

items.text: While you are in your father's house, follow him and do not act on your own.
items.quote: 집의 이셔ᄂᆞᆫ 아비ᄅᆞᆯ 좃고 — while in the home, follow the father

items.text: After you marry, follow your husband and do not act on your own initiative.
items.quote: 사ᄅᆞᆷ의게 가ᄂᆞᆫ 지아비ᄅᆞᆯ 좃고 — after going to her husband, follow the husband

items.text: When your husband is dead, follow your son and do not direct your own affairs.
items.quote: 지아비 죽거든 아ᄃᆞᆯ을 조차 — when the husband dies, follow the son
items.conflict: Scripture: 'Children, obey your parents'; parents retain authority over children, not vice versa.

items.text: Do not go out of the inner quarters; stay at home and occupy yourself with the preparation and serving of food.
items.quote: 긔걸을 閨門에 내디 아니ᄒᆞ며 일이 음식을 이 밧ᄂᆞᆫ ᄉᆞ이예 이실 ᄯᆞᄅᆞᆷ이니라 — she does not put her steps outside the women's quarters; her work is only in serving food
items.conflict: Scripture does not confine women to the home; modesty and diligence are required, not total seclusion.

items.text: Do not take as wife a daughter of a rebellious or disorderly house, of a family with criminals or hereditary disease, or a fatherless eldest daughter.
items.quote: 겨집이 다ᄉᆞᆺ 取티 아니홈이잇ᄂᆞ니 반逆ᄒᆞᆫ 집 ᄌᆞ식을 取티 말며 어즈러온 집 ᄌᆞ식을 取티말며 — There are five kinds not to take: do not take a daughter of a rebellious house; do not take a daughter of a disorderly house
items.conflict: God shows no partiality; do not reject a person for family background or orphanhood.

items.text: You may put away your wife for these seven causes: disobedience to your parents, bearing no son, adultery, jealousy, incurable disease, talkativeness, or theft.
items.quote: 겨집의 닐곱가지 내팀이 잇ᄂᆞ니 父母ᄭᅴ 順티 아니커든 내티며 아ᄃᆞᆯ 업거든 내티며 淫란커든 내티며 — There are seven grounds for expelling a wife: if she is disobedient to parents, expel her; if she has no son, expel her; if she is adulterous, expel her
items.conflict: Jesus permits divorce only for sexual immorality; God hates divorce for other reasons.

items.text: Do not divorce your wife if she has no home to return to, if she has mourned with you for your parents, or if she was poor with you before you became rich.
items.quote: 세 가지 내티디 아니미 잇ᄂᆞ니 取ᄒᆞᆫ 배 잇고 갈배 업거든 내티디 말며 — There are three cases not to expel: if she has a home but no place to go back to, do not expel her

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 14 … 夫婦章 15

items.text: Be faithful to your husband even unto death; die for his righteous cause, not for his pleasure.
items.quote: 妾은 王義예 죽고 王 즐김애 죽디 아니ᄒᆞ노이다 — I die for the king's righteousness, not for his pleasure.
items.conflict: A wife must not take her own life; God alone has authority over life.

items.text: Bury your father with honor; do not leave him unburied.
items.quote: 그리ᄒᆞᆫ 後에아 군ᄉᆞᄅᆞᆯ 罷ᄒᆞ야 도라와 昭王ᄋᆞᆯ 무드니라 — After that, they dismissed the army and returned and buried King Zhao.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 11 … 夫婦章 13

items.text: Remonstrate with him when he gives himself to pleasure, and by your own self-denial move him to repent and govern diligently.
items.quote: 樊姬ㅣ 諫ᄒᆞ시니 마디 아니커시늘 즘ᄉᆡᆼ의 고기ᄅᆞᆯ 먹디아니ᄒᆞ신대 — Fan Ji remonstrated; when he did not listen, she would not eat meat.

items.text: Do not seek to keep his affection for yourself alone; set aside private jealousy and help him take worthy women, that public right may not be obstructed.
items.quote: 쳡은 엇디 王의 괴이며ᄉᆞ랑호을 혼자 가지고 쟈아니 ᄒᆞ리잇고 — How should I wish to keep the king's love and affection for myself alone?
items.conflict: Concubinage resists Christ's one-flesh marriage of one man and one woman (Matthew 19:4-6).

items.text: Listen to your wife's wise remonstrance, and for her sake turn from folly to diligence in your calling.
items.quote: 王이 改過ᄒᆞ샤 政事ᄅᆞᆯ 브즈러니 ᄒᆞ시니라 — The king repented and attended diligently to government.

items.text: Do not make a light promise to die with him for pleasure; refuse such a vow, and instead urge him to abandon pleasure-seeking and attend to government.
items.quote: 婢子와 죽음으로 ᄡᅥ 긔약ᄒᆞ시ᄂᆞ니 그를 可히得ᄒᆞ리잇가 — You make a promise to die with your maidservant; can that be right?

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 24

items.text: Give your daughter in marriage to a man of integrity, not to one rich or powerful.
items.quote: 아비 그 淸렴ᄒᆞ고 고로옴을 긔특이 녀긴고로 ᄯᆞᆯ로 ᄡᅥ 妻ᄒᆞ니라 — Her father valued his integrity and poverty, and so gave him his daughter as wife.

items.text: Guide your wife to give up luxury and embrace the modest estate of your house.
items.quote: 能히 이ᄀᆞᆮᄒᆞ면 이내 ᄠᅳ디라 — If you can do this, it is my wish.

items.text: Obey your husband's will in all things, and do not set your own preferences against his.
items.quote: 오직 命을 조초리이다 — I will only obey your command.

items.text: Serve your husband in daily needs, as with towel and comb, and do not despise humble work.
items.quote: 以賤妾으로 슈건과 빗슬 뫼ᄋᆞᆸ게 — made me, a lowly wife, serve with towel and comb.

items.text: Lay aside your own wealth and finery, and live as your husband lives, even in poverty.
items.quote: 조ᄎᆞᆫ 사ᄅᆞᆷ과 服飾을 다 보내고 다시 뎌른 뵈 치마 ᄆᆡ여 — sent away all her attendants and finery and wore a short cloth skirt.

items.text: On entering your husband's home, present yourself before your mother-in-law and pay her the respect due.
items.quote: 싀어 믜게 뵈ᄂᆞᆫ 녜ᄅᆞᆯ ᄆᆞᆺ고 — finished the ceremony of showing herself to her mother-in-law.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 母儀章第五 모의장 · The Mother's Example · 母儀章 6 … 母儀章 8

items.text: Keep your promise to your dead husband to raise his child well, and put the stepchild's safety before your own comfort.
items.quote: 내게 맛뎌 닐오ᄃᆡ 잘 기르라 ᄒᆞ야ᄂᆞᆯ 내 닐오ᄃᆡ 그리 호마 호니 — he entrusted him to me saying, Raise him well, and I promised to do so.

items.text: Love your stepchildren as your own; do not favor your biological children over them in clothing, food, or care.
items.quote: 繼母ᄂᆞᆫ 친어미 ᄀᆞᄐᆞ니 ᄂᆞᆷ의 어미 되야셔 能히 그 아ᄃᆞᆯ을 ᄉᆞ랑티 아니ᄒᆞ면 가히 慈ㅣ라 니ᄅᆞ랴 — A stepmother is like a real mother; if she cannot love his child, can she be called loving?

items.text: When your child does wrong, correct him firmly; refuse ill-gotten goods and uphold righteousness.
items.quote: 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 니러가라 — Son, depart.

items.text: Do not disgrace your parents by unrighteous gain; an unfilial son is no son.
items.quote: 義 아닌 財믈이 내 둘 거시 아니며 孝도 아니ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 내 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 아니니 — Goods gained unrighteously I will not keep; a son who is not filial is not my son.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 16 … 夫婦章 17

items.text: Serve the empress with all sincerity and carefulness; in dress, bearing, and speech yield to her and do not outshine her.
items.quote: 陰后ᄅᆞᆯ셤기샤ᄃᆡ 일 져므리 저흐시며 조심ᄒᆞ시며 — In serving Empress Yin she feared and was careful.

items.text: Treat those of your own rank with self-restraint, humbling yourself and not contending.
items.quote: 同列을 ᄃᆡ졉ᄒᆞ샤ᄃᆡᄆᆡ양 몸을 이긔여 ᄂᆞᆺ기 ᄒᆞ시며 — In dealing with her equals she always restrained herself and lowered herself.

items.text: Show grace and kindness even to palace servants and menial laborers.
items.quote: 비록 宮人 隷役이라도隷役은쳔인이라 다 恩혜ᄅᆞᆯ 더으신대 — Even to palace women and menial servants she extended grace.

items.text: If you bear no sons, present worthy women to your husband so that the line may not fail.
items.quote: ᄌᆞ식이 넙디 못ᄒᆞᆯ가 근심ᄒᆞ샤 ᄆᆡ양 눈믈 디며 한숨디흐샤 ᄌᆞ조 才人을 ᄲᅡ드리샤 — Worried she had no children, she wept and often presented talented women.
items.conflict: Christian marriage is monogamous (Gen 2:24; 1 Tim 3:2).

items.text: Do not ask that your mother and brothers be admitted to the inner palace, lest they cause harm to those above and below.
items.quote: 上下ㅣ서르 損홈을 진실로 願티 아니ᄒᆞ노이다 — I truly do not wish that both high and low be harmed.

items.text: When the empress is out of favor, decline to attend the emperor's presence, so as not to profit from her misfortune.
items.quote: 陰后ㅣ 졈졈 疎커ᄂᆞᆯ ᄆᆡ양 뫼와 뵈올 제 當ᄒᆞ샤 곳 병으로ᄡᅥ ᄉᆞ양ᄒᆞ더시다 — When Empress Yin gradually became estranged, she excused herself with illness.

items.text: When the empress plots against you, do not answer back or seek revenge, but grieve that you have failed to serve her aright.
items.quote: 내 졍셩을 다ᄒᆞ며 ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ을 다ᄒᆞ야 ᄡᅥ 皇后ᄅᆞᆯ 셤교ᄃᆡ ᄆᆞᄎᆞᆷ애 돕ᄂᆞᆫ 배 되디 못호니 맛당이 하ᄂᆞᆯ긔 罪ᄅᆞᆯ 어드리로다 — I served the empress with all my heart, but could not help; I deserve punishment from heaven.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 20 … 夫婦章 21

items.text: Personally oversee his meals; serve him with reverence and ensure the food is clean.
items.quote: 婦人의 남편 셤굠은 삼가디 아니ᄒᆞ디 못ᄒᆞ리며 음식 올려 나옴은 조히 아니 ᄒᆞ디 못ᄒᆞ리니 — A wife’s serving her husband must be respectful, and the food she presents must be clean.

items.text: Counsel him not to forget hard times, but to stay vigilant in days of peace.
items.quote: 陛下ㅣ 어려운 시졀을 닛디 마ᄅᆞ샤 治安ᄒᆞᆫ 날의 警戒ᄒᆞ쇼셔 — Do not forget the hard times, but be vigilant in days of peace.

items.text: Remember the hardships shared together and remain careful day and night.
items.quote: 妾이 ᄯᅩ 患難애 서ᄅᆞ 좃차 ᄃᆞᆫ니던 일을 닛디 아니ᄒᆞ야 朝夕에 조심호리이다 — I will not forget following you in hardship; I will be cautious day and night.

items.text: Teach those raised in wealth to know that silk-making is difficult and not to take it lightly.
items.quote: 富貴예 ᄉᆡᆼ댱ᄒᆞ얀 맛당이 蠶桑이 쉽디아니홈을 알올ᄯᅵ니 — Those raised in wealth ought to know that sericulture is not easy.

items.text: Be filial; this is part of benevolence and righteousness.
items.quote: 孝도ᄒᆞ며 慈홈이 곳 仁義옛 일이니 — Filial piety and parental kindness are the work of benevolence and righteousness.

items.text: Be kind to your children; this is part of benevolence and righteousness.
items.quote: 孝도ᄒᆞ며 慈홈이 곳 仁義옛 일이니 — Filial piety and parental kindness are the work of benevolence and righteousness.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 22 … 夫婦章 23

items.text: Obey your parents' daily instructions; do not leave your assigned task to gawk at what attracts others.
items.quote: 妾이 父母의 敎를 드러 ᄲᅩᆼ을 ᄠᆞ고 大王을 보ᄋᆞ오라 혼敎ᄅᆞᆯ 듯디 아니홈이니이다 — I have received my parents' teaching to pick mulberry, and have not received teaching to look at Your Majesty.

items.text: Do not go with a man without your parents' consent; such a one is a runaway and brings shame.
items.quote: 妾으로 父母의 敎ᄅᆞᆯ 듯디 아니ᄒᆞ고 大王을 좃ᄌᆞ 오면 이ᄂᆞᆫ 奔女ㅣ니 — If I follow Your Majesty without my parents' teaching, I become a runaway woman.

items.text: Preserve your chastity; if the marriage rites are not properly performed, refuse the union even if threatened with death.
items.quote: 貞女ㅣ ᄒᆞᆫ례되나 ᄀᆞᆺ디아니커든 비록 주그나 좃디 아니ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니이다 — A chaste woman, if one rite is not correct, even if she dies will not follow.

items.text: Counsel your husband to frugality and moderation, and away from the ruin of extravagance.
items.quote: ㄲᅮᆷ이며 아니ᄭᅮᆷ이미 서르 머로미 千과 萬이라도 오히려 足히 니ᄅᆞ디 못ᄒᆞ리니 — Between adorning and not adorning, the distance is more than a thousand or ten thousand.

items.text: Heed your wife's wise counsel and put it into practice for the good of your household.
items.quote: 王이 宿瘤女ᄅᆞᆯ ᄀᆞ장 감동ᄒᆞ샤 ᄡᅥ 后ᄅᆞᆯ 삼으시고 令을 내샤 집을 ᄂᆞᄌᆞ기 ᄒᆞ시며 모ᄉᆞᆯ몌오시며 음식을 더르시며 풍류을 더르시며 後宮이 두 비츨못 닙게 ᄒᆞ시니 — The king, deeply moved, made her queen, issued orders to lower the house, fill up the moat, reduce food and music, and forbid the harem to wear two colors.

items.text: Seek your husband's esteem by inner virtue rather than by outward adornment; do not busy yourself with display.
items.quote: 웃디 말라 ᄭᅮ미디 아니ᄒᆞᆯ ᄯᆞᄅᆞᆷ이라 — Do not laugh; it is only that she does not adorn herself.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 1 … 夫婦章 5

items.text: Obey him and serve him with respect; do not disobey or rebel.
items.quote: 오직 順從홈을 알고 敢히 어긔롯처 ᄇᆡ반티 말올ᄯᅵ니 — Only know obedience; do not dare disobey or rebel.

items.text: Receive his teaching and admonition as you would the words of a sage.
items.quote: ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치며 경계홈을 드로ᄃᆡ 聖인의 글 드롬 ᄀᆞᆺ티 — Listen to his teaching and warning as if hearing a sage's writing.

items.text: If he has a fault, remonstrate gently, and if he beats you, do not resent it.
items.quote: 비록 티믈 닙어도 엇디 敢히 怨恨ᄒᆞ리오 — Even if you are beaten, how dare you resent?
items.conflict: Husbands must love their wives as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:25), not beat them.

items.text: Ask and report to him even in trivial matters; do not act on your own authority.
items.quote: 터럭만ᄒᆞᆫ 일을 반ᄃᆞ시 ᄎᆔ품ᄒᆞ고 알외올 ᄯᅵ니 엇디 敢히 스ᄉᆞ로 ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ대로 ᄒᆞ리오 — Even in a hair's-breadth matter, ask and report; how dare you act on your own?

items.text: Do not tell your parents of your husband's family's faults, lest you add to their worry.
items.quote: 지아븨집 허믈을父母ᄭᅴ 니ᄅᆞ디 말올ᄯᅵ니 ᄒᆞᆫ갓 어버의 시름을 기티ᄂᆞᆫ디라 — Do not tell your parents of your husband's family's faults; it only adds to your parents' worry.

items.text: Regard his home as your own and remain committed to him for life.
items.quote: 지아비ᄅᆞᆯ 어더 임의 도라가ᄂᆞᆫ 죽으며 살옴으로 ᄡᅥ 홀 ᄯᅵ니 — Having married him, you have gone to him; with him determine life and death.

items.text: Be harmonious and respectful toward each other, like the ospreys.
items.quote: 서르 和樂ᄒᆞ시며 恭敬ᄒᆞ샤미 雎鳩 ᄀᆞᆺᄒᆞ시다 — They are harmonious and respectful, like the ospreys.

items.text: Govern your wife with wisdom, so that dignity is not destroyed.
items.quote: 지아비 어디디 몯ᄒᆞ면 겨집을 거느리디 몯ᄒᆞ고 — If a husband is not wise, he cannot govern his wife.

items.text: Teach your daughters as well as your sons, so they learn to serve a husband and keep propriety.
items.quote: 오직 아ᄃᆞᆯ을 ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치고 ᄯᆞᆯ을 ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치디 아니ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니 — They teach only sons and do not teach daughters; this too is an error.

items.text: Practice lasting respect and obedience; do not become overly familiar, lest you despise him.
items.quote: 敬과 順ᄒᆞᆫ 道ᄂᆞᆫ 婦人의 큰 禮라 — Respect and obedience are the great rite of a woman.

items.text: Do not contend or justify yourself in disputes; yield and remain lowly.
items.quote: 直ᄒᆞ니ᄂᆞᆫ ᄃᆞ토디 아니티못ᄒᆞ고 曲ᄒᆞ니ᄂᆞᆫ 발명티 아니티 못ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니 — If you are right you cannot but contend; if wrong you cannot but justify; this leads to anger, so honor compliance and lowliness.

items.text: Do not scold or beat your wife; preserve the grace and righteousness of your union.
items.quote: 夫婦ㅣ 義로 ᄡᅥ 和親ᄒᆞ고 恩으로 ᄡᅥ 好合ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ 거시어늘 매질이 임의 行ᄒᆞ면 므슴 義 이시며ᄭᅮ지즈미 임의 베프면 므슴 恩혜 이시리오 — Husband and wife are harmonized by righteousness, joined by grace; if beating has been done, what righteousness remains? If scolding has been spread, what grace remains?

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 言行章第一 언행장 · Words and Conduct · 言行章 13 … 言行章 17

items.text: Love your son with natural affection, as the Sage taught that father and son should be close.
items.quote: 아비와 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 親홈이이시며 — Father and son have affection.

items.text: Maintain the proper distinction between husband and wife, as the Sage taught.
items.quote: 지아비와 겨집이 ᄀᆞᆯᄒᆡ요미 이시며 — Husband and wife have distinction.

items.text: Observe the order between old and young; give proper deference to your elders.
items.quote: 얼운과 져므니 ᄎᆞ례 이시며 — Old and young have order.

items.text: Be a fortunate, virtuous person, not a wicked one; the wicked ruin the clan and cut off the descendants.
items.quote: 크면 宗族을 업티며 ᄌᆞ손이 ᄭᅳᆫ허디ᄂᆞ니 — if great, ruin the clan and cut off descendants.

items.text: As a wife, do not go out at night; if you must, carry a bright candle.
items.quote: 겨집이 밤의 나디 아니ᄒᆞ니 밤의 날 적은 ᄇᆞᆯ근 燭ᄋᆞᆯ잡으라 — a woman does not go out at night; if going out at night, hold a bright candle.

items.text: Do not compose writings or circulate them to others; keep your learning private for modesty.
items.quote: 셰샹 겨집의 글지이와 글쓰므로 ᄂᆞᆷ의게 傳홈을 보고 깁히 ᄡᅥ외오 녀겨 ᄒᆞ더라 — seeing women transmit their writings to others, she deeply despised it.

items.text: In poverty be content; in wealth be wary, so that you do not despise kin and break familial affection.
items.quote: 가난ᄒᆞ니ᄂᆞᆫ 가난홈을편안히 녀기고 가ᄋᆞᆷ여니ᄂᆞᆫ 가ᄋᆞᆷ열믈 경계홀디니 — The poor should be content with poverty, the rich should be wary of wealth.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 22

items.text: Be frugal and diligent; do not indulge in luxury, for it endangers a high position.
items.quote: 사치하며 고온 것을 즐기지 아니하시며 — she did not indulge in luxury or pretty things.

items.text: When he is angry, do not act in haste; entrust judgment to proper channels so that reward and punishment are fair.
items.quote: 怒홈으로 刑벌을 더으디 아니 — do not increase punishment out of anger.

items.text: Honor the ancestors: join in the rites at the ancestral hall, prepare the offerings yourself, and show utmost reverence.
items.quote: 몸소 음식을 맹그라샤 誠敬을 힘써 극진이 — she personally prepared the food and was utmost in sincerity and respect.
items.conflict: Offering food to ancestors as worship conflicts with the biblical teaching that worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Treat the secondary consorts with kindness, and those who have children with even greater generosity.
items.quote: 妃嬪으로 써 아래를 대접하샤대 은혜를 두시며 … 대접을 더 후히 — She treated the consorts with kindness, and those with children more generously.

items.text: Since you enjoy blessings without merit, work diligently at women's tasks to repay heaven's favor.
items.quote: 공 업시 福을 밧음이 造物의 아쳐하는배니 … 겨집의 일을 브즈러니 — receiving blessings without merit is odious to the Creator; be diligent in women's work.

items.text: Urge your sons to study diligently and not disgrace their birth.
items.quote: 너희 小子는 맛당이 니음을 생각하여 나흔 바를 辱하지 말올지니라 — You little ones should remember this and not disgrace your birth.

items.text: Instruct your sons to be loyal and generous, cultivating virtue, not presuming on fortune.
items.quote: 忠厚를 많이 하여야 자손이 길리니 … 스스로 믿고 德을 힘쓰지 아니 — be very loyal and generous so that descendants prosper; do not trust yourself and neglect virtue.

items.text: When they vie over possessions, correct them and lead them to study the sages with teachers and friends.
items.quote: 반드시 스승을 親히 하며 벗을 사괴야 聖賢의 學을 講論 — you must be close to teachers and friends and discuss the learning of the sages.

items.text: Admonish your husband to prepare for famine by storing grain beforehand.
items.quote: 賑恤할 법 이숌이 뎨축을 몬져 예備홈만 같지 못하니 — having relief measures is not as good as laying up stores beforehand.

items.text: Urge your husband to provide generously for the wise men who serve him.
items.quote: 朝廷이 하늘 祿으로 써 天下애 어딘 사람을 치니 … 賢을 치기는 豊히 하고져 — the court uses heaven's emolument to nourish the wise; desire to be generous toward the worthy.

items.text: On your deathbed, urge your husband to seek wise men, heed remonstrance, govern clearly, and teach the sons.
items.quote: 맛당이 어딘이를 求하시며 諫을 드르시며 政事를 발키혀샤 … 모든 아들을 가르치샤 — you should seek the wise, listen to remonstrance, make government clear, and teach all the sons.

items.text: Manage the household so that your husband is not burdened with trivial domestic concerns.
items.quote: 內政을 하나로 帝께 번거로이 아니하샤 — she alone managed the inner affairs and did not trouble the emperor.

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 言行章第一 언행장 · Words and Conduct · 言行章 18 … 言行章 21

items.text: Do not disgrace your ancestors or ruin the family name; rather uphold their loyalty, filial piety, diligence, and frugality.
items.quote: 先世를 辱ᄒᆞ이며 집을 일홈이 그 허믈이 더옥 크니 — to disgrace ancestors and ruin the family's name are grave faults.

items.text: Obey your father's dying charge: do not neglect a small good, and do not commit a small evil.
items.quote: 사오나온 거시 젹다 ᄒᆞ야 ᄡᅥ ᄒᆞ디 말며 어딘 거시 젹다 ᄒᆞ야 ᄡᅥ 아니ᄒᆞ디 말라 — Do not do an evil because it is small; do not fail to do a good because it is small.

items.text: Heed the elder's teaching: examine yourself as strictly as you blame others, and excuse others as leniently as you excuse yourself.
items.quote: 사ᄅᆞᆷ ᄎᆡᆨ망ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ으로 ᄡᅥ 몸을ᄎᆡᆨ망ᄒᆞ고 내 몸 졉어 보ᄂᆞᆫ ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ으로 ᄡᅥ 사ᄅᆞᆷ을 졉어보면 — Use the mind that blames others to blame yourself, and the mind that excuses yourself to excuse others.

items.text: Obey your uncle's warning: never speak of others' faults, treating them as if they were your parents' names.
items.quote: 사ᄅᆞᆷ의 허믈 듯고父母 일홈 들옴ᄀᆞ티 ᄒᆞ야 귀예 可히 시러곰 들을 ᄲᅮ니언뎡 입에 可히 시러곰 니ᄅᆞ디 못ᄒᆞ과뎌 — When you hear others' faults, treat them as your parents' names: the ear may hear, but the mouth may not speak.

items.text: Follow your uncle's advice: imitate the cautious and upright man, not the bold and chivalrous one, lest you become frivolous.
items.quote: 伯高ᄅᆞᆯ 效측ᄒᆞ야 得디 못ᄒᆞ야도 오히려 조심ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ 션ᄇᆡ 되리니 — If you imitate Bogao and fail, you will still become a cautious scholar.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 廉儉章第七 염검장 · Integrity and Frugality · 廉儉章 7 … 廉儉章 11

items.text: Serve him by laboring with your own hands for food and clothing.
items.quote: 몸소 밧 가라ᄡᅥ 밥을 ᄒᆞ며 親히 질삼ᄒᆞ야 ᄡᅥ 옷슬ᄒᆞ야 — personally plowing to make food and weaving to make clothes.

items.text: Urge him to refuse office and riches that would compromise his integrity.
items.quote: 만일 사ᄅᆞᆷ의 重ᄒᆞᆫ 綠을 바ᄃᆞ며... 쟝ᄎᆞᆺ 엇디ᄡᅥ ᄃᆡ졉ᄒᆞ리오 — If you receive another's heavy salary, ride another's strong horses, eat another's fat meat, how will you face them?

items.text: Refuse what would cast doubt on your father's uprightness; protect his good name.
items.quote: 죽은 아비 일ᄌᆞᆨ 白金으로 ᄡᅥ 사ᄅᆞᆷ을 맛디디아년ᄂᆞ니라 — My dead father never entrusted gold to anyone.

items.text: Build a home that is modest and fitting, for it is to be handed down to your descendants.
items.quote: 살 집은 맛당히 子孫의게 傳ᄒᆞᆯ 거시니 — a dwelling should be handed down to descendants.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 敦睦章第六 돈목장 · Harmony among Kin · 敦睦章 6 … 敦睦章 8

items.text: Serve your husband's parents by preparing their food, even in times of want.
items.quote: 네 어미로 더브러 내 어버이ᄅᆞᆯ 養ᄒᆞᆯ 제 네어미 親히 밥짓기를 잡으되 — When I was poor, with your mother I served my parents; your mother personally cooked.

items.text: Provide for your parents while they live; do not let them go hungry or cold.
items.quote: 이제 厚ᄒᆞᆫ 祿을 어더 ᄡᅥ 어버이ᄅᆞᆯ 養코져 ᄒᆞ나 어버이 잇디 아니ᄒᆞ시며 — Now that I have obtained a generous salary, I wish to serve my parents, but they are gone.

items.text: Do not enjoy wealth while your poor kinsmen go hungry and cold; share your prosperity with them.
items.quote: ᄎᆞ마 너희 무리로 富貴의 樂을 누리게 ᄒᆞ랴 ... 주리며 치워ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니를 내 엇디 시러곰 어엿비 녀기디아니ᄒᆞ리오 — How can I bear to let you enjoy wealth and honor? ... how can I not pity those who are hungry and cold?

items.text: Protect your brother's child even at cost to your own, for public righteousness outweighs private affection.
items.quote: 내 아ᄃᆞᆯ은 私ᄉᆞᆺ ᄉᆞ랑이오 兄의 아ᄃᆞᆯ은 公번된 義니 — My own son is private love; my brother's son is public duty.
items.conflict: Scripture commands parents to provide for their own household (1 Tim 5:8); no duty to nephew overrides parental duty.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 6 … 夫婦章 10

items.text: Do not leave your husband or take another; regard him as heaven from which you cannot flee.
items.quote: 지아비ᄂᆞᆫ 다시 娶ᄒᆞ논 義 잇고 겨집은 두 번 가ᄂᆞᆫ 법文이 업스니 — The husband has the right to remarry; the wife has no rule for marrying twice.
items.conflict: Allows a husband to remarry while forbidding a wife; Scripture holds both to the same standard and permits remarriage after death (Romans 7:2-3).

items.text: Make your heart whole and your countenance upright; let your ears, eyes, speech, and steps avoid all that is improper; do not join gatherings or peep at the gate.
items.quote: ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ을 온젼이 ᄒᆞ며 ᄂᆞᆺ빗ᄎᆞᆯ 正히 ᄒᆞ야 — Make the heart whole and the countenance upright.

items.text: Yield wholly to your parents-in-law; even when your mother-in-law blames you wrongly, obey her command and do not argue right or wrong.
items.quote: 싀어미 닐오ᄃᆡ 너를 그르니라 ᄒᆞ야도 오히려 命을 順호미 맛당ᄒᆞ니 — Even if the mother-in-law says you are wrong, still obey the command.
items.conflict: Requires obedience to in-laws even in what is wrong; Scripture says 'We must obey God rather than men' (Acts 5:29) and a wife's primary earthly loyalty is to her husband (Genesis 2:24).

items.text: Serve your parents-in-law with filial piety and carefulness; humble yourself and act only after consulting them.
items.quote: 舅姑ᄅᆞᆯ 程太中의 夫人 侯氏ㅣ 셤교ᄃᆡ 孝도ᄒᆞ며 삼가오므로 — Lady Hou served her parents-in-law with filial piety and carefulness.

items.text: Do not be jealous or harsh; keep a gentle, impartial heart so the household is harmonious.
items.quote: 偏頗 업슴이 이 닐온 德 읫 ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ이니 집이 맛당이 절로 和ᄒᆞ리라 — Without partiality... this is the heart of virtue; the house will naturally be harmonious.

items.text: Extend benevolence to servants and concubines; consider their hunger and cold, balance their work and rest, and scold only when unavoidable.
items.quote: 죵이며 쳡의게 니르러 맛당이 仁으로 미롤ᄯᅵ니 — Toward servants and concubines, extend benevolence.

items.text: Confine yourself to food, clothing, and ceremonies; assist your husband in his deficiencies and do not usurp authority.
items.quote: 君子ᄅᆞᆯ 도와 그 不足ᄒᆞᆫ 거ᄉᆞᆯ 勸ᄒᆞᆯ ᄲᅮᆫ이넌뎡 — Should only assist the gentleman and encourage what is lacking.
items.conflict: Restricts a wife's role to domestic tasks; Scripture shows women serving in broader capacities (Proverbs 31:16-24; Judges 4:4; Acts 18:26).

items.text: Treat your husband with the courtesy of a guest; do not act on even small matters without consulting him.
items.quote: 비록 져근 일이라도 일즉 오로디 아니ᄒᆞ야 반ᄃᆞ시 ᄉᆞᆯ온 後에야 行ᄒᆞ더라 — Even in small matters she did not act arbitrarily but acted only after consulting.

items.text: Live in harmony without a day of discord; from youth to old age avoid jesting or improper laughter even in private.
items.quote: 夫婦ㅣ 되야 한ᄃᆡ 사롬이 여슌ᄒᆡ예 일즉 ᄒᆞᄅᆞ도 ᄂᆞᆺ블키미 업스며 — As husband and wife, in harmony there was never a day of discord.

items.text: Manage work with a measure that is neither excessive nor negligent; do not become lazy or abandon your duties.
items.quote: 너모 어그러워 게을으며 프러 ᄇᆞ리기예 니르디 마롤ᄯᅵ니라 — Do not go to excess, laziness, or abandonment.

items.text: Receive your wife's help with respect and increase your courtesy toward her.
items.quote: 太中이 안해 도옴을 힘 닙어 禮敬이 더옥 至극커든 — Taizhong, relying on his wife's help, increased his respect and courtesy toward her.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 敦睦章第六 돈목장 · Harmony among Kin · 敦睦章 1 … 敦睦章 5

items.text: Treat a sister-in-law as a sibling: meet harshness with gentleness, and do not contend for small profit to break with close kin.
items.quote: 죠고맛 利ᄅᆞᆯ ᄃᆞ토아 ᄡᅥ至親ᄋᆞᆯ 어그게 마롤ᄯᅵ어다 — Do not compete for small profit and so break with your closest kin.

items.text: Before seeking friendships outside, be sure your parents and kin are well pleased; do not put off filial piety while they live.
items.quote: 親戚이 임의 업스면 비록 孝코져 ᄒᆞᆫᄃᆞᆯ 누를 爲ᄒᆞ야 孝ᄒᆞ리오 — If your relatives are gone, though you wish to be filial, for whom will you be filial?

items.text: Do not put off brotherly respect; treat your elder sibling with honor while you both live.
items.quote: 나히 임의 늘그면 비록悌코져 ᄒᆞᆫᄃᆞᆯ 누를 爲ᄒᆞ야 悌ᄒᆞ리오 — When you are old, though you wish to be brotherly, for whom will you be?

items.text: As a daughter-in-law, do not sow discord between brothers or compete for private wealth; obey the head of the house and keep the family whole.
items.quote: 다른 姓이 서르 모다길기ᄅᆞᆯ ᄃᆞ토며 뎔으기를 ᄃᆞ토아... 門ᄋᆞᆯ ᄂᆞᆫ호며 집을베혀 두리믈 도賊과 원讐ᄀᆞ티 ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니 다 너희 婦人의 저즈는배니라 — Women of different surnames vie and wrangle, dividing the gate and splitting the house, making brothers like thieves and foes; all this is your doing.

items.text: Love an elder brother as a father and protect him as a child; ask after his food and clothing.
items.quote: 伯康이 나히 쟝ᄎᆞᆺ 여든이어ᄂᆞᆯ 公이 위와드되 아비 ᄀᆞ티 ᄒᆞ고 保호ᄒᆞ되 어린 아ᄒᆡ ᄀᆞ티 ᄒᆞ야 — When Bokang was nearly eighty, he served him like a father and cared for him like a little child.

items.text: When an elder sister is ill, do not leave her care to servants; serve her yourself while there is time.
items.quote: 그 ᄆᆞᆺ누의病들거든 반ᄃᆞ시 親히 爲ᄒᆞ야 블 일러 粥 쑤더니 — When his eldest sister fell ill, he always personally lit the fire and cooked porridge.

items.text: Do not abandon a brother in plague; stay and nurse him day and night, even at risk of infection.
items.quote: 親히 스스로 扶持ᄒᆞ야 낫과 밤의조오디 아니ᄒᆞ며 그 ᄉᆞ이예 ᄯᅩ 관을 ᄆᆞᆫ져 슬피 울기를 그치디아니ᄒᆞ더니 — He personally supported him, not sleeping day or night, and held the coffin and wept without ceasing.

items.text: Do not let anger over a lost ox break brotherly harmony; remain calm and do not rebuke him.
items.quote: ᄇᆞᆯ셔 알안노라ᄒᆞ고 ᄂᆞᆺ빗치 自若ᄒᆞ야 글 닑기를 그치디 아니ᄒᆞ더라 — He said 'I already know,' his face serene, and did not stop reading.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 廉儉章第七 염검장 · Integrity and Frugality · 廉儉章 1 … 廉儉章 6

items.text: Keep the family's tradition of purity and frugality unbroken from one generation to the next.
items.quote: 우리 집이 본ᄃᆡ 가난ᄒᆞᆫ 결레라 셰셰로 淸白으로 ᄡᅥ 서르 닛고 — Our family has been poor, and from generation to generation we have handed down pure integrity.

items.text: Provide your descendants with enough for their clothing and food, but do not store up surplus wealth for them.
items.quote: 子孫ᄋᆡ 옷밥이 ᄌᆞ연 有餘ᄒᆞ리이다 — My descendants will have enough for clothing and food.

items.text: Practice frugality yourself so that your household does not grow accustomed to luxury and later come to ruin when fortune changes.
items.quote: 집 사ᄅᆞᆷ이 샤치예 닉언디 임의 오란다라 能히 믄득 검박디 못ᄒᆞ야 반ᄃᆞ시 失所호매 니르리니 — My household, long accustomed to extravagance, cannot suddenly become frugal and will surely lose their place.

items.text: Take only what is needful: clothing to cover cold, food to fill hunger; do not covet finery or excess.
items.quote: 平生애 오ᄉᆞᆯ 치위 ᄀᆞ리옴만 取ᄒᆞ며 음식을 ᄇᆡ예 ᄎᆡ올만 ᄎᆔ호ᄃᆡ — All my life I have taken clothing only to cover cold and food only to fill my belly.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 母儀章第五 모의장 · The Mother's Example · 母儀章 3 … 母儀章 5

items.text: Serve your husband's mother and grandmother with morning and evening diligence, excelling in the way of a wife.
items.quote: 太姒ㅣ 太姜과 太任ᄭᅴ 괴이샤 아ᄎᆞᆷ 나죄 勤勞ᄒᆞ샤 ᄡᅥ 婦道애 나ᄋᆞ시니라 — Tai Si was good to Tai Jiang and Tai Ren; morning and evening she was diligent, excelling in the way of a wife.

items.text: Manage the inner household as your husband manages the outer.
items.quote: 文王은밧글 다ᄉᆞ리시고 文母ᄂᆞᆫ 안ᄒᆞᆯ 다ᄉᆞ리시니라 — King Wen managed the outside; Mother Wen managed the inside.

items.text: Train your children from childhood to adulthood, never showing them anything wicked or perverse.
items.quote: 太姒ㅣ 열아ᄃᆞᆯ을 ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치샤ᄃᆡ 졈은 적으로 브터 ᄌᆞ라매 밋처 일즉 邪僻ᄒᆞᆫ 일을 뵈디아니ᄒᆞ더시다 — Tai Si taught her ten sons from childhood to adulthood, never showing them wicked or perverse things.

items.text: Choose your home in a place conducive to your child's moral formation, even if you must move.
items.quote: 孟母ㅣ ᄀᆞᆯ오ᄃᆡ 이 ᄡᅥ 아ᄃᆞᆯ 살릴배 아니라 ᄒᆞ고 올마 學宮 겻틔 가집을 ᄒᆞ니 — Meng's mother said, 'This is not the place to raise a son,' and moved to live beside a school.

items.text: Never deceive your child; if you say you will do something, do it.
items.quote: 소기면 이ᄂᆞᆫ 밋브디 아니홈으로 ᄀᆞᄅᆞ침이라 — If I deceive him, that is teaching him not to trust.

items.text: Discipline your child strictly, setting rules and requiring obedience, even while you love him.
items.quote: 申國夫人이 性이 嚴ᄒᆞ고 法도ㅣ 이셔 비록 甚히 公을 ᄉᆞ랑ᄒᆞ나 그러나 공을 ᄀᆞᄅᆞ쵸ᄃᆡ 일일마다 規矩ᄅᆞᆯ 조차 ᄇᆞᆲ드듸게ᄒᆞ더니 — The Lady of Shen was strict and had rules; though she loved him greatly, she taught him to follow rules in everything.

items.text: Stand in attendance before your parents all day, and do not sit until told, even in cold, heat, or rain.
items.quote: 계오 열설에 큰 치위와 더위와 비올 제라도 뫼셔 셧기를 날이 ᄆᆞᆺ도록 ᄒᆞ야 안ᄌᆞ라 니ᄅᆞ디 아니커든 敢히 안ᄯᅵ 아니ᄒᆞ더라 — At ten, even in great cold, heat, or rain, he stood in attendance all day; unless told to sit, he did not dare sit.

items.text: In the presence of your parents, wear proper attire and avoid unseemly places, sounds, and writings.
items.quote: 正티 아니ᄒᆞᆫ 글월과 禮 아닌 비ᄎᆞᆯ 일즉 ᄒᆞᆫ 적도 눈에 브티디아니ᄒᆞ더라 — He never let improper writings or non-ritual colors touch his eyes.

items.text: Provide your children a strict and upright teacher, as Zhengxian Gong invited Jiao Xiansheng.
items.quote: 正獻公이 블러 마자 ᄒᆞ여곰모단 아ᄃᆞᆯᄅᆞᆯ ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치더니 — Zhengxian Gong called him and had him teach all his sons.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 16

items.text: Manage the household and care for your mother when she is ill.
items.quote: 집 일ᄅᆞᆯ 가ᄋᆞᆷ아라다ᄉᆞ리샤 죵ᄃᆞᆯᄒᆞᆯ 긔걸ᄒᆞ시니 — she took charge of household affairs and commanded the servants.

items.text: Serve your mother-in-law with respect.
items.quote: 陰皇后ᄅᆞᆯ 밧드러 셤기시며 — she served Empress Yin.

items.text: Treat your fellow wives with propriety and kindness.
items.quote: 同列을 겻흐로 ᄃᆡ졉ᄒᆞ샤ᄃᆡ 禮則이닷ᄀᆞ시며 — she treated those of the same rank with propriety and courtesy.
items.conflict: With monogamy (Gen 2:24; Mt 19:5).

items.text: For the sake of children, bring other women to your husband.
items.quote: 左右ᄅᆞᆯ 薦達ᄒᆞ샤ᄃᆡ — she recommended those around her.
items.conflict: With monogamy (Gen 2:24; Mt 19:5).

items.text: Be frugal in your dress and household expenses.
items.quote: 샹해 굴근 깁을 니브시고 치마애 션 두로디아니 ᄒᆞ더시니 — she always wore coarse silk and did not put a border on her skirt.

items.text: Give your husband wise counsel in difficult matters.
items.quote: 帝ㅣᄌᆞ조后ᄭᅴ 뭇ᄌᆞᆸ거시든 后ㅣ ᄀᆞᆯᄒᆡ 집어 理예 맛게 ᄒᆞ샤 — the emperor often asked her, and she analyzed and judged according to principle.

items.text: Teach the children the classics and moral principles.
items.quote: 모ᄃᆞᆫ져믄 王을 論語와 經書ᄅᆞᆯ ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치시며 — she taught all the young princes the Analects and the classics.

items.text: Endure your own discomfort so as not to distress your grandparent.
items.quote: 알픔을 ᄎᆞᆷ으샤 니ᄅᆞ디 아니 ᄒᆞ거시니ᄂᆞᆯ — she endured the pain and did not speak of it.

items.text: Mourn your father with fasting and tears for the mourning period.
items.quote: 三年이 ᄆᆞᆺ도록소곰과 ᄂᆞ믈을 자시디 아니ᄒᆞ샤 — for three years she did not eat salt or vegetables.

items.text: Do not request or accept undue honors for your own relatives from your son.
items.quote: 내 엇디 可히 우흐로 先帝 ᄠᅳᆺ을 져 ᄇᆞ리고 아래로先人의 德을 ᄒᆞ야 ᄇᆞ려 다시 西京의敗亡ᄒᆞᆫ禍ᄅᆞᆯ 조ᄎᆞ리오 — How could I, above, cast aside the former emperor's intent, and below, cast aside the virtue of my ancestors, and again follow the disaster of the Western Han's ruin?

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 20

items.text: Support him in hardship, enduring hunger yourself if need be, and provide for him even at cost to your own comfort.
items.quote: 일즉 스ᄉᆞ로 ᄇᆡ 골ᄑᆞᄆᆞᆯ ᄎᆞᆷ으시고 ᄆᆞᄅᆞᆫ 밥과 포육을품으샤 帝ᄭᅴ 밧ᄌᆞ오샤 — She herself endured hunger and carried dried rice and preserved meat in her bosom to offer to the emperor.

items.text: Keep his important documents carefully and produce them promptly when needed.
items.quote: 즉시 ᄂᆞᄆᆞᆺ 체내야 드리샤 일즉 그릇 아니터시다 — She immediately brought them out and handed them over, never once misplacing them.

items.text: Counsel him to rule with mercy, not killing or plundering, to win the people's hearts.
items.quote: 사ᄅᆞᆷ 죽이디 아니호ᄆᆞ로ᄡᅥ 근본삼아 업더 디나니ᄅᆞᆯ 븟들며 위ᄐᆡᄒᆞ니ᄅᆞᆯ 救ᄒᆞ야 — Make not killing people the foundation; support the perishing and rescue the endangered.

items.text: When he prospers, remind him of past need and urge him not to forget his subjects.
items.quote: 貧賤에 닛디 아니ᄒᆞ시니 願컨대 群臣 百姓을 艱難애 닛디마ᄅᆞ쇼셔 — Since you have not forgotten me in poverty, please do not forget your subjects in difficulty.

items.text: Warn him against pride and extravagance, for ruin begins in small things.
items.quote: 驕縱홈이 奢侈예 나며 危亡이 忽微예 니러날가 — Pride and indulgence spring from extravagance; danger and ruin arise from the minute.

items.text: Urge him to value worthy men and forgive small faults.
items.quote: 져근 허믈를 赦ᄒᆞ야 ᄡᅥ 그 사ᄅᆞᆷ을 보젼홀 ᄯᅵ니이다 — Forgive small faults to preserve the person.

items.text: Love and raise your nephews and nieces as your own children.
items.quote: 기르샤ᄃᆡ ᄉᆞ랑홈을 내 나흐니ᄀᆞᆺ티 ᄒᆞ더시니 — She raised them, loving them as if she had given birth to them.

items.text: Supervise the women's work and manage the household diligently.
items.quote: 宮妾을 고찰ᄒᆞ샤 겨집의 일을 다ᄉᆞ리샤 — She supervised the palace women and managed women's work.

items.text: Record and teach family models so descendants may walk in them.
items.quote: 命ᄒᆞ샤 家法과 어딘 ᄒᆡᆼ실을 긔錄ᄒᆞ야 ᄆᆡ양 외오여 드르샤고 — She ordered them to record family laws and virtuous conduct and read them aloud regularly.

items.text: Remember her faithfulness in hardship and honor her accordingly.
items.quote: 夫婦ㅣ 서르 保젼홈은 쉽고 — Husband and wife preserving each other is easy.

heading: 內訓跋文 내훈발문 (transcribed heading: 內重拔文) · Afterword · 內訓跋文 1

items.text: Serve your parents-in-law day and night without laziness; personally prepare their food and do not leave their side.
items.quote: 兩宮을 셤기샤 晝夜에 게어르지 아니ᄒᆞ더시니 밋 冊봉ᄒᆞ야 嬪이 되시매 더옥 婦道를 삼가샤 몸소 御饌을 잡으샤 左右에 ᄯᅥ나지 아니ᄒᆞ시니 — She served both palaces day and night without slackness; when she became Crown Princess, she was even more careful in wifely duty, personally prepared the royal meals and did not leave their side.

items.text: When your grandchildren commit a fault, do not cover it up, but immediately admonish them with a serious countenance.
items.quote: 育ᄒᆞ신 바 王孫 等이 져기 過失이 이시면 죠곰도 掩護ᄒᆞ지 아니 ᄒᆞ시고 곳 正色ᄒᆞ야 誡飭ᄒᆞ실 ᄉᆡ — When the royal grandchildren she raised had any fault, she did not cover it up at all, but immediately with a serious face admonished them.

items.text: Teach your children strictly, that they may bring blessing to the nation.
items.quote: 子ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치기ᄅᆞᆯ 嚴히 ᄒᆞ야 — Strictly taught their children.

items.text: Diligently instruct the younger women, being concerned for their ignorance.
items.quote: 女婦의 無知ᄒᆞ믈 근심ᄒᆞ샤 孜孜히 訓誨ᄒᆞ시나 — Worried about women's ignorance, she diligently instructed them.

items.text: Learn and recite the teachings in your spare time, morning and evening, that you may know how to manage your household well.
items.quote: 女工 겨ᄅᆞᆯ에 아ᄎᆞᆷ의 닉이고 져녁의 외와 ᄆᆞᄋᆞᆷ의 頑味ᄒᆞ면 곧 뎜뎜 克家ᄒᆞᆯ 道ᄅᆞᆯ 알리니 — In spare time from women's work, reciting morning and evening and pondering in heart, they will gradually know the way to manage the household.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 母儀章第五 모의장 · The Mother's Example · 母儀章 9

items.text: Warn him against unrighteous gain: let his poverty in office be good news, his wealth be ill news.
items.quote: 가난ᄒᆞ야 군핍ᄒᆞ야 能히 보존티 못ᄒᆞ더라 ᄒᆞ면 이ᄂᆞᆫ 됴ᄒᆞᆫ 긔별이어니와 — If you hear he is poor and cannot keep himself, that is good news.

items.text: When your child in office brings gifts, ask where they came from; do not rejoice over goods gotten by unrighteousness.
items.quote: 내 죵내이거시 어드러 조차오뇨 묻디 아니ᄒᆞ니 — they do not ask where it came from.

items.text: Love stepchildren as your own, making no difference between them and those you bore.
items.quote: 모든 庶ᄌᆞᄅᆞᆯᄉᆞ랑호ᄃᆡ 내 나ᄒᆞ니와 달리 아니ᄒᆞ더니 — She loved all stepchildren as her own, not different from her own.

items.text: When your husband is angry with the children, plead for them and soften his wrath.
items.quote: 先公이 怒ᄒᆞ샤미 잇거든 반ᄃᆞ시 爲ᄒᆞ야 누겨 프로ᄃᆡ — When their father was angry, she always interceded for them.

items.text: Do not hide your child's faults from his father; a son's unfilialness comes from a mother's concealment.
items.quote: 子식의 不肖ᄒᆞᆫ바ᄂᆞᆫ 어미 그 허믈을 가리와 아비 아디 몯ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ 탓시라 — A son's unfilialness is because the mother hides his fault from the father.

items.text: Teach your children not to scold servants: though ranks differ, persons are the same; remember you could not do the work when young.
items.quote: 貴賤이비록 다ᄅᆞ나 사ᄅᆞᆷ은 ᄒᆞᆫ가지니 네 이만 큰 시졀에 能히 일을ᄒᆞ던 다 몯ᄒᆞ던 다 — Though noble and base differ, people are one; when you were young, could you do the work?

items.text: Do not rush to comfort a child who falls; correct him, saying, 'If you walked carefully, you would not have fallen.'
items.quote: 네 만일 편안히 날호여 ᄃᆞᆫ니면 엇디 업더디리오 — If you walked carefully, how would you fall?

items.text: Train your children not to be picky about food or harsh in speech; correct them early lest desire rule them when grown.
items.quote: 져므셔 ᄒᆞ고져 홈을 맛게 호려 ᄒᆞ면 ᄌᆞ라ᄂᆞᆫ엇더리오 — If you allow your desires when young, what will you be when grown?

items.text: When your child quarrels and is angry, teach him to worry about his inability to yield, not about failing to win.
items.quote: 能히 屈티 몯홈을 근심홀 ᄯᅵ언뎡 펴디 몯홈을 근심말라 — Worry about not being able to yield, not about not being able to prevail.

items.text: Provide good teachers and companions for your children; even in poverty, gladly prepare food for their guests.
items.quote: 비록 가난ᄒᆞ나 손을 맛고져 ᄒᆞ거든 깃거 머글 거슬 ᄀᆞᆺ초더라 — Though poor, when guests came, she gladly prepared food.

items.text: Be ready to bear the penalty yourself to shield your stepchild from harm.
items.quote: 내 맛당히 坐ᄒᆞᆯ 소이다 — I ought to be the one punished.

items.text: Honor your stepmother as your own mother, even to taking the blame in her place.
items.quote: 初ㅣ 맛당히 좌죄ᄒᆞ리이다 — I, Chu, ought to be punished.

heading: 內訓 卷第二 · 夫婦章第四 부부장 · Husband and Wife · 夫婦章 18 … 夫婦章 19

items.text: Serve the ancestral temple with reverence as part of your husband's lineage.
items.quote: 皇后의 尊홈이 날과 體 ᄀᆞᆮᄒᆞ야宗廟ᄅᆞᆯ 셤기며 — The empress's dignity is one with mine; she serves the ancestral temple.
items.conflict: Worship of the dead is not commanded; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: When your husband raises you to high honor, decline out of modesty and confess your unworthiness.
items.quote: 깁히 덕이 져거 小君 ᄀᆞᆯᄒᆡ샴애 몌우미 足디 못호이다 — I deeply lack virtue and am not worthy to be called Xiaojun.

items.text: Be frugal in household expenses; forbid luxury and accept only what is needful.
items.quote: 다 ᄒᆞ여곰 禁ᄒᆞ야 ᄭᅳᆫ케 ᄒᆞ시고 歲時예 오직 죠ᄒᆡ와 먹을밧틸 ᄯᆞᄅᆞᆷ이러라 — She forbade all [tribute] and at the new year received only paper and food.

items.text: Do not plead for offices or honors for your own kin; restrain family ambition.
items.quote: 帝 ᄆᆡ양 登氏ᄅᆞᆯ 벼슬ᄒᆞ이고져 켜시든 后ㅣ곳 슬피 비ᄋᆞ와 ᄉᆞ양ᄒᆞ시므로 — When the emperor wished to give offices to the Deng family, the empress sorrowfully begged and declined.

items.text: As guardian, nurture the child in your keeping, protect him from danger, and set him in his rightful place.
items.quote: 애 기르더니 — She raised the child.

items.text: Treat your husband's other consorts with generosity and honor them when they leave to keep his tomb.
items.quote: 黃金 三十斤과 雜帛 三千匹와 白越 四千 긋ᄒᆞᆯ주라 — thirty jin of gold, three thousand bolts of mixed silk, and four thousand pieces of white Yue cloth.
items.needs_role: co-wife (secondary consort of the deceased husband)

items.text: When a wrong is suspected, examine the matter yourself and do not punish without proof; let the guilty confess.
items.quote: 親히 宮人을 보샤 顔色을 보와 ᄉᆞᆯ피시니 卽時예 首服ᄒᆞ니라 — She personally observed the palace women's faces, and the guilty one confessed.

items.text: Protect a faithful servant from slander; weigh the charge against his known character and investigate.
items.quote: 모딘 말이업더니 ... 人情에 맛디 아니타 — never spoke an evil word ... contrary to human feeling.

heading: 內訓 卷第三 · 母儀章第五 모의장 · The Mother's Example · 母儀章 1 … 母儀章 2

items.text: Choose for your child a wet nurse and teacher who is generous, kind, benevolent, warm, virtuous, respectful, careful, and of few words.
items.quote: 어위고 넉넉ᄒᆞ며 인慈ᄒᆞ고 은惠로오며 溫화ᄒᆞ고어딜며 온恭ᄒᆞ고 조심ᄒᆞ며 삼가며 말삼 드믈게 ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니ᄅᆞᆯ 求ᄒᆞ야 — seek one who is gentle, generous, kind, benevolent, warm, virtuous, respectful, careful, and of few words

items.text: Teach them age-appropriate propriety: use the right hand when eating, give proper replies (boys quickly, girls slowly), separate boys and girls at seven, and teach them to yield to elders at eight.
items.quote: 能히 밥을 먹거든 ᄀᆞᄅᆞ치되 올ᄒᆞᆫ 손으로 ᄡᅥ ᄒᆞ며 能히 말ᄉᆞᆷᄒᆞ거든 ᄉᆞ나ᄒᆡᄂᆞᆫ 唯ᄒᆞ고 겨집은 兪ᄒᆞ며 — when the child can eat, teach him to use the right hand; when he can speak, boys answer 'wei' and girls 'yu'

items.text: At ten, keep daughters at home, have them follow the teacher's instruction, and learn women's work (hemp, ramie, thread, silk, weaving) to make clothing.
items.quote: 삼과 모시ᄅᆞᆯ 자브며 실과 고티ᄅᆞᆯ 다ᄉᆞ리며 뵈 ᄧᆞ며 다회 다하 겨집의 일을ᄇᆡ화 ᄡᅥ 衣服을 ᄆᆡᆼ글 ᄯᅵ니라 — grasp hemp and ramie, handle thread and silk, weave cloth, make ribbons, learn women's work to make clothing

items.text: Teach girls the classics and women's precepts; do not teach them to compose songs, poetry, or popular music.
items.quote: 女子ᄅᆞᆯ ᄀᆞᄅᆞ쳐 놀애와 詩ᄅᆞᆯ 지이며 셰俗앳 음樂 잡음을 ᄀᆞ라치ᄂᆞ니 ᄌᆞ믓 맛당티 아니ᄒᆞ니라 — teaching girls to compose songs and poetry and popular music is quite improper

items.text: If a daughter-in-law is disrespectful or unfilial, first teach her, then rebuke, then beat; if she still does not change, expel her; but do not publicize her fault.
items.quote: ᄌᆞ조 티되 ᄆᆞᄎᆞᆷ내 고티디 아니커든 며느리ᄅᆞᆯ 내틸 ᄯᅵ니 — if beating often does not change her, expel the daughter-in-law
items.conflict: Expelling a daughter-in-law for unfilial behavior exceeds biblical grounds for divorce (Matt 19:9).

items.text: If a son is disrespectful or unfilial, first teach, then rebuke, then beat; if he persists, expel him; do not publicize his fault.
items.quote: ᄌᆞ조 티되 ᄆᆞᄎᆞᆷ내 고티디 아니커든 아ᄃᆞᆯ을 내티며 — if beating often does not change him, expel the son
items.conflict: Disowning a son for unfilial behavior may conflict with biblical admonition of adult children; beating an adult is not prescribed.

items.text: Raise them diligently, do not indulge them, correct faults early; accept responsibility if they turn out unworthy.
items.quote: 아ᄒᆡ 허믈 이쇼미 다 어믜 길옴이니 — a child's faults are all due to the mother's raising

items.text: During pregnancy, avoid evil sights, sounds, words, and improper food; listen to upright poetry at night; be careful what you are affected by, because the child will resemble it.
items.quote: 그 娠이 이시매... 눈에 사오나온 빗츨 보디 아니ᄒᆞ시며 귀예 淫난ᄒᆞᆫ 소ᄅᆡ랄 듯디 아니ᄒᆞ시며 입에 敖만ᄒᆞᆫ 말ᄉᆞᆷ을 내디 아니ᄒᆞ더시니 — when she was pregnant, she did not look at bad sights, did not listen to licentious sounds, did not utter arrogant words
items.conflict: The belief that prenatal impressions determine a child's moral character is not biblical; the heart is shaped by God and instruction (Prov 22:6).

items.text: Wait for elders before eating and learn to yield to others.
items.quote: 飮食호매 반ᄃᆞ시 얼운의 後에 ᄒᆞ야 — at meals always after elders

items.text: Arrange proper marriage with betrothal, not elopement; have children marry at the proper ages.
items.quote: 스믈히어든 혼인ᄒᆞᆯ ᄯᅵ니... 聘ᄒᆞ면 妻ㅣ 되옴이오 奔ᄒᆞ면 妾이 되ᄂᆞ니라 — at twenty, marry; if properly betrothed, wife; if elopes, concubine

items.text: Have children observe the sacrifices by arranging wine, water, vessels, kimchi, and pickles, and assisting the rite with propriety.
items.quote: 祭祀ᄅᆞᆯ 보아 술과 믈과 대 그릇과 나모 그릇과 팀ᄎᆡ와 젓과 드려 노흐며 禮로 졔 尊을 도을ᄯᅵ니라 — observe the sacrifices, arrange wine, water, bamboo and wooden vessels, kimchi and pickles, and assist the rite with propriety
items.conflict: Ancestral offerings conflict with the second commandment; we honor the dead by remembering, not offering.

items.text: Be respectful and filial toward your parents.
items.quote: 며느리 공敬 아니ᄒᆞ며 孝도 아니커든 — if a daughter-in-law is not respectful or filial

heading: 內訓 卷第一 · 孝親章第二 효친장 · Filial Devotion to Parents · 孝親章 10

items.text: Respect those whom your parents loved, even after their death, and do not grow slack.
items.quote: 비록 父母 ㅣ 업스샤도 몸이 업도록공경ᄒᆞ야 衰티 아니ᄒᆞᆯᄯᅵ니라 — Even if parents are gone, honor them to the utmost and do not slacken.
items.needs_role: a child of a concubine or of a servant whom the parents loved

items.text: In clothing, food, and work, do not set your own preference over your parents' for a concubine, even after they are gone.
items.quote: 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 두 쳡을 둠애 ... 衣服과 飮食브터며 일 잡옴브터ᄅᆞᆯ 父母 ᄉᆞ랑ᄒᆞ시ᄂᆞᆫ 바와 敢히 ᄀᆞᆯ와 말아 — When a son has two concubines, in clothing, food, and work, dare not go against the one his parents love.
items.conflict: concubinage/polygamy (Gen. 2:24; 1 Tim. 3:2)

items.text: If your parents dislike your wife, send her away; if they say she serves well, live with her as husband and wife and do not slacken.
items.quote: 父母ㅣ 깃거 아니커시ᄃᆞᆫ 내티고 ... 父母ㅣ 니ᄅᆞ샤ᄃᆡ 이 날ᄅᆞᆯ 잘 셤긴다 ᄒᆞ시거든 아ᄃᆞᆯ이 夫婦 禮ᄅᆞᆯ 行ᄒᆞ야 — If your parents are not pleased, put her away; if they say she serves well, perform the rites of husband and wife.
items.conflict: divorce for parents' displeasure (Matt. 19:6)

items.text: Ask your mother-in-law about every matter in ancestral rites and receiving guests when your father-in-law is dead.
items.quote: 싀아비 죽으면 싀어미 늙ᄂᆞ니 ᄆᆞᆺ 며느리祭祀와 손ᄃᆡ 졉ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ 바애 므릇 일을 반ᄃᆞ시 싀어마님ᄭᅴ 請ᄒᆞ고 — When the father-in-law is dead and mother-in-law old, the eldest daughter-in-law must ask her mother-in-law about all matters of sacrifices and receiving guests.

items.text: Ask the eldest daughter-in-law about matters, as she asks her mother-in-law.
items.quote: 버근 며느리ᄂᆞᆫ ᄆᆞᆺ 며느릐게 請홀ᄯᅵ니라 — The younger daughter-in-law must ask the eldest daughter-in-law.

items.text: Obey your parents-in-law's orders without laziness.
items.quote: 싀아비 싀어미 ᄆᆞᆺ며느리ᄅᆞᆯ 브리거시든 게어르디 말며 — If father-in-law and mother-in-law give orders to the eldest daughter-in-law, be not lazy.

items.text: Do not be rude to the younger daughter-in-law.
items.quote: 감히 버근 며느리게 無禮히 말올ᄯᅵ니라 — Dare not be rude to the younger daughter-in-law.

items.text: Do not rival the eldest daughter-in-law, nor go, order, or sit as her equal.
items.quote: 敢히 ᄃᆡ뎍ᄒᆞ여 ᄧᅡᆨ호려 말아 敢히 ᄀᆞᆯ와 ᄃᆞᆫ니디 말며敢히 ᄀᆞᆯ와 命ᄒᆞ디 말며 敢히 ᄀᆞᆯ와 안디 말올ᄯᅵ니라 — Dare not set yourself up as her rival; dare not go, order, or sit with her.

items.text: Do not go to your own home without their command, and in every matter small or great ask your parents-in-law.
items.quote: 믈읏 며느리 ᄉᆞᄉᆞᆺ 집의 命ᄒᆞ야 가라ᄒᆞ디 아니커시ᄃᆞᆫ 敢히 믈러가디 못ᄒᆞ며 며느리 쟝ᄎᆞᆺ 일이 잇거ᄃᆞᆫ ... 반ᄃᆞ시싀부모ᄭᅴ 請홀ᄯᅵ니라 — If not commanded to go to her own home, a daughter-in-law dare not return; in any matter she must ask her parents-in-law.

items.text: In every good or evil, consider your parents' name: do what brings them honor, avoid what brings them shame.
items.quote: 父母ㅣ 비록 업스시나 ... 父母ᄭᅴ 어딘 일홈 기티ᄆᆞᆯ ᄉᆡᆼ각ᄒᆞ야 ... 반ᄃᆞ시 결단히 아니홀ᄯᅵ니라 — Even if parents are gone, think to bring them a good name and avoid disgrace, and so decide firmly.

items.text: On your birthday, if your parents are gone, be doubly sorrowful; do not set out wine and make merry.
items.quote: 사람이 父母ㅣ 업스면 生日에 반ᄃᆞ시 倍히 슬허홀 ᄯᅵ니 다시엇디 ᄎᆞᆷ아 술을 두고 풍류를 ᄒᆞ야 ᄡᅥ 즐김을 ᄒᆞ리오 — If one has lost parents, on his birthday he must be doubly sad; how can he bear to set out wine and enjoy music?

items.text: Serve your parents with gentle remonstrance and no opposition; attend them constantly; work diligently to death and wear deepest mourning for three years.
items.quote: 어버이ᄅᆞᆯ 셤교ᄃᆡ隱홈이 잇고 犯홈이 업스며 ... 일을 브즈러니ᄒᆞ야 죽으매 니르며 거상을 극진이 홈을 三年을 홀ᄯᅵ니라 — Serve parents with hidden remonstrance and no opposition; be diligent to death and wear deepest mourning for three years.
